environment.scope: Actual Linux x86_64 GPUI app and installed SDK, X11/Xvfb software rendering, private 48 kHz stereo PulseAudio null sink. Resource, native input, revision and cleanup evidence only; no physical DAC, GPU presentation or IME measurement. See evidence/linux-m2-2026-10-04/README.md for commands and limits.

target_platform.scope: Linux native software-rendered controls/resources pass; physical audio/presentation and hardware unplug/drain timing remain pending. This does not qualify other platforms or a release.

output_clock.criteria: Physical live-output timestamps demonstrate A/V error no greater than one video-frame duration plus the measured timestamp residual.

audio_modes.criteria: Native evidence covers playing, pause, seek, mute, silent media, no-device, device loss/reconnect, underrun, and end/replay behavior.
audio_modes.notes: Focused callback/clock tests cover silence, underrun, stale packets and device loss; real virtual CPAL and native input cover playback, mute, pause, superseded seek, no-device/retry, end/replay and teardown. Physical device loss/reconnection and drain latency remain unqualified.

revision_handoff.criteria: Rebuild handoff keeps audio, video, revision, and clock epoch matched and preserves the old playable revision on precommit failure.
revision_handoff.notes: Native workload performs 50 paused/playing rebuilds, including five deliberate compile failures, with sampled audio identity/epoch checks. Explicit real SDK regression passes failed-build, invalid-source, cancel/re-prime and cleanup checks. The retry log also retains a historical timeline cleanup failure; its corrected final rerun is separately retained.

native_controls.criteria: Native play, pause, scrub, frame-step, end/reset, timeline, and rebuild controls remain responsive with paused seek p95 at most 150 ms.
native_controls.notes: Real pointer/key input and virtual output pass; warm seek p95 is 96.23249 ms to image submission, not physical presentation. Inspected paused screenshot matches frame 100 / 3.333 s. Resizing increases CPU scale from 0.183333 to 0.529688 while preserving generation/position; inspected paused resized frame is 70 / 2.333 s. A short window with the failed-build banner uses the existing center-pane scroll to reach lower tracks/thumbnails.

pixel_parity.criteria: Known color and straight-alpha frames meet recorded CLI CPU pixel tolerances and shader capability gaps are explicitly diagnosed.
pixel_parity.notes: Ordinary CLI CPU RGBA matches at frames 0 and 137; independent geometry checks cover thumbnail-to-full and same-size frame 19 changes, alpha 128 and color swatches. Sequential 44.1 kHz stereo WAV/PCM maximum difference is 0.0000460409 and mean is 0.000009305 for 242,550 frames. Shader gap is explicit.

resource_stress.criteria: A 10-minute session with at least 2,000 seeks and 50 rebuilds records bounded queues/caches and steady RSS slope at most 2 MiB/min.
resource_stress.notes: 600.276649 s, 2,001 confirmed seeks and 50 rebuilds. RSS slope 1.228500 MiB/min; pane-sized CPU rendering keeps all sampled bounds: one render request, 12 thumbnail requests, thumbnail high-water 14 entries / 806,400 bytes, one resident/queued main image. There were 10,358 renders and 13 late frames. Initial full-size run failed at 4.986848 MiB/min and left one PCM/build lease; before-adaptive-raw.json preserves that failure.

cleanup.criteria: Close releases PCM and artifact leases, reports no image release failures, and leaves no owned worker, build, audio, port, or worktree resources.
cleanup.notes: Graceful WM_DELETE_WINDOW exit; owned-process, orphaned-child and PCM/materialization inventories are empty. Main/thumbnail release failures are zero. Owned Xvfb and PulseAudio are stopped. No worktree was created; compilation caches, logs and evidence are not live artifact leases.
